depicted_variant: Buaya air asin putih raksasa Seri Pahang menyambar melalui laut gelap dalam duel, bukan naga serpentin.

visual_requirements.description: Buaya air asin putih raksasa, satu kepala2mata4kaki1ekor, tanpa tanduk naga.
Dalam pertarungan laut menjadi gelap, guruh dan kilat; ombak dari serbuan tubuh.
Laut di lepas pantai Pahang dalam duel Seri Kemboja.

aura: Buaya putih raksasa seri-pahang-c01, tekad menantang demon seri-pahang-c08, laut gelap/kilat duel seri-pahang-c12 memberi keagungan.
artistic_choices: Seri Kemboja tidak divisualkan karena detail wujud kurang; aksi duel lewat arah serangan.
Tidak menggabungkan varian naga/silver scales c07/c20, tidak ada emas transformasi pail pada adegan duel.
Ukuran giant diperlihatkan melalui small waves/wreck-free sea, bukan korban; kilat cuaca cerita tidak diklaim berasal dari tubuh.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of SERI PAHANG, the legendary GIANT WHITE saltwater crocodile fighting the black sea demon off Pahang.
ANATOMY: ONE saltwater CROCODILE head with TWO eyes, giant WHITE crocodile body with FOUR short reptilian legs and ONE powerful long tail; massive white ridged scutes, broad tooth-lined jaw; NO horns, no dragon limbs, no human parts. [seri-pahang-c01]
MOMENT: smashing diagonally through towering black sea waves and snapping its jaws toward an unseen opponent near the viewer, claws churning white foam, one eye fixed forward in battle.
POWER: the story's duel darkens the sea, thunder rolls and lightning flashes; one natural lightning bolt lights white scales, physical sea spray from its lunge. No energy breath, no victim/gore. [seri-pahang-c12]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme sea-level low angle; enormous white head and jaws dominate, small distant cresting waves show giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one violent natural lightning flash, deep walnut-black ocean, heavy rain and white foam.
SURFACE: battered white crocodile scutes, wet thick scales, rough teeth, crashing seawater.
SETTING: sea off the coast of Pahang during its duel. [seri-pahang-c01,seri-pahang-c08,seri-pahang-c12]
MOOD: awe-inspiring courageous protector in battle, overwhelming, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native dan200px dilihat: buaya putih raksasa satu kepala2mata, dua kaki depan terlihat/kaki belakang di air, ekor dan scutes jelas tanpa tanduk. Serbuan jaws melalui gelombang dan natural lightning/cuaca duel seri-pahang-c12 membuat bahaya/keagungan kuat.7Uji Sangar semua ya; tanpa korban, kuasa breath, teks/glyph/gore/desainadaptasi.

root_visual_review.notes: Giant white saltwater crocodile charging through storm waves with lightning overhead; one head, four legs, no dragon horns.
